provenance.rssBasis: VmRSS and VmHWM from /proc/<engine pid>/status, read every 0.5 s from 1 s after launch until the engine process exits (load, prefill and decode inside the window); memoryMedianResidentMB = median of the VmRSS reads, memoryPeakResidentMB = the largest VmHWM read (the kernel's resident high-water mark since process start); kB / 1024; executorch: memoryPeakResidentMB = the larger of that and the harness's own peak (memoryPeakEngineReportedMB: getrusage ru_maxrss at the end of the decode, its stderr line 'RSS after finishing text generation', MiB, as llama_main logs it)
provenance.definitions:
native-benchmark-

x row (scripts/executorch/native_bench/et_native_bench.cpp over the tag's runner components, the ones llama_main builds): P token ids, no text, in one TextPrefiller::prefill call, the first token sampled from its logits (greedy), then D - 1 decode steps with ignore_eos. prefill tok/s = prompt_tokens / (prompt_eval_end_ms - inference_start_ms) * 1000: the prefill call and the first token's sampling; no tokenization (there is no text). TTFT ms = first_token_ms - inference_start_ms = the same window. decode tok/s = the stats line's generated_tokens (the decode loop's D - 1 steps) / (inference_end_ms - prompt_eval_end_ms) * 1000, as llama_main's; generatedTokenCount = D, the prefill-sampled token included (nativeBenchmark: sampledFromPrefill 1 + decodeForwardSteps D - 1). cold = one generation in a fresh et_native_bench process (no warmup). Clock: integer milliseconds (extension/llm/runner/util.h time_in_ms).
